items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Now we have already now played the Paramount Theater with Bing Crosby when he first got there, with Frank Sinatra when he first got there, were on the bill with these guys at the Paramount.

ctx.x: It would have been bigger than what it was if the manager hadn't been so selfish in his own way. He didn't want us to get a name because he thought we'd leave him, that's why he was like that. But I had a thought, I just had a thought of making a name. I had to fight like a dog to get that name up in lights, man. That was some trouble, I mean that was trouble. Anyway, getting back to the point of doing the shorts and finding the checks and all, he got worse instead of getting better. I didn't think he was going…

didn't pay nothing. What I said -- here's a sad story like every time I think of it I'd almost cry, to think I was robbed of my goodness, same as Buck would have been robbed of his talent. If he had stayed in school with book learning to do what with, get what? Sad. However, from the Pathe' studio we come back to New York. We came back to New York and come back on the Pantages circuit, from New York to California on the Pantages circuit. Now we have already now played the Paramount Theater with Bing Crosby when…
Were you the only black act?
